policy_cards.title: Cancellation must restore stock reservation balances
policy_cards.requirement: Cancelling an invoice must increase available inventory and decrease reserved inventory for each affected line.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Cancelling an invoice must increase available inventory and decrease reserved inventory for each invoice line.
policy_cards.requirement_test: Reserved inventory must be restored when invoice is cancelled

policy_cards.title: Paid invoices cannot be cancelled by normal cancellation
policy_cards.requirement: Paid invoices must return an error from the normal cancellation path.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Paid invoices must return an error from the normal cancellation path.
audit_questions: Does the spec reject paid invoice cancellation?
